text: ふけば　どんな　ポケモンでも　とびおきると　いう　ふえ。

structure.jp: どんな　ポケモンでも　とびおきると　いう
structure.en: said to make any Pokémon jump awake

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if' that action is done. ふけば = 'if you blow it'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.span: どんな　ポケモンでも
patterns.explanation: どんな plus a thing plus でも means 'no matter what kind'. どんな　ポケモンでも = 'any Pokémon at all'.

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: とびおきると　いう　ふえ
patterns.explanation: という between a description and a thing means 'that is said to', passing on what people say about it. とびおきると　いう　ふえ = 'a flute said to make them jump awake'.
